exposure: intrathecal isobaric levobupivacaine with buprenorphine adjuvant
outcome: onset and duration of sensory blockade
onset and duration of motor blockade
cohort: 50 patients of ASA grade I/II undergoing laparoscopic appendicectomy surgery.
finding: The addition of Buprenorphine to intrathecal isobaric levobupivacaine is safe, maintains hemodynamic stability, prolongs postoperative analgesia, and delays the request for first rescue analgesics.
